assumptions: SOL column = public VR200 spec peaks (BF16 4 / FP8 17.5 / FP4 35 PF dense, HBM4 22 TB/s, NVLink6 1.8 TB/s per direction), hop = one CUDA-graph node (0.78 us), zero per-kernel gap. Achievable column = our Hecate measurements (3.65 / 10.9 / 21.1 PF, 13.9 TB/s, 1.25 TB/s ingress, 2.86 us hop, 0.78 us per kernel). No fitted derating.
FP32 SIMT rate (KDA recurrence, conv) = 212 SMs x 128 lanes x 2 x 2.424 GHz = 131.6 TF in both columns (not measured).
Per-op roofline t = max(FLOPs/peak[dtype], bytes/HBM); ops are additive (no cross-op overlap) except two-microbatch O1.

Ops flagged fused_in_sol (conv, gate/beta norm, o_norm, act, gate_mul, top-k of MoE, latent_norm, ...) carry no activation HBM traffic. Op-level SOL fusions (O7) are always on: fused indexer score+select (no logits scratch), final AttnRes mix and drafter context rows only for consumed rows (last token / last 2048 per request in prefill, accepted rows in decode), Markov vocab shard reused from L2 across the k positions when it fits (<= 64 MiB).
FP8 MLA KV is the standard 576-B row (512 latent + 64 rope FP8); MXFP4 indexer key 68 B; DSA KV = 15,456 B/token.

KDA state per request = one FP32 recurrent state (434 MB) + FP32 conv (3+k columns) + RecoverSSM records (6.78 MB x q); the deployed allocator reserves far more (workload.md) - that gap is an implementation item.

mxfp4_release routed experts run W4A8 at the FP8 MMA rate with MXFP8 dispatch (3696 B/route); O4 (NVFP4 activations, FP4 rate, 2016 B/route) is not in the headline because the mission fixes MXFP8 activations.

nvfp4_modelopt: experts NVFP4 W4A4 at FP4 rate (2016 B/route), KDA projections + shared experts MXFP8 at FP8 rate; MLA, router, latent, dense L0, lm_head BF16. KV/state precision identical to mxfp4_release.
Routing is uniform: experts touched per GPU = (896/E) x (1 - (1 - 16/896)^(rows in EP domain)); EP imbalance 1.0 in both columns (O5 is a sensitivity knob, not applied).
All-reduce / reduce-scatter take the cheaper of the implemented primitives (NVLS 2 hops vs one-shot / push 1 hop) per column; NVLS per-GPU bytes ~M in, M(1+1/N) out (comm.json).

Async comm (ShardQ context push on the copy engine) hides under the attention compute of the same layer; all other comm is exposed unless O1 (two microbatches, t_layer = max(compute, comm), weights streamed twice) is on.
DcpExchange top-k merge bytes 1536 B per row per peer (inferred); sharded verify 100 B per row per peer.

Capacity: HBM budget 272.48 GiB (measured free at vLLM start) - resident weights - 16 GiB reserve (activations, graphs, symmetric buffers, MegaMoE arena). r_max is per GPU (a group of N holds N x r requests).

Prefill chunks are packed from AgentX requests with 5,456 fresh tokens each over a 72.9K prefix (fresh-weighted mean); L_ref = 78.4K. Headline = best chunk size per engine in {4K..64K} that fits HBM (0.5 MB per row of live activations assumed). KDA state checkpoint export for the prefix cache is counted (CKPT=1).

Decode reference context 135K (mission); r_max also reported at the OSL-weighted 189K. AL = golden 3.08/3.81/4.16 at k=3/5/7. Draft = one parallel 5-layer pass on k query rows + k sequential Markov steps.
DSA-DP owner balance and DP lock-step padding are taken as perfect (SOL); D10 split indexer therefore only adds comm here - its value is under owner skew, which the SOL model does not price.

PP (P7) stages are balanced by a DP partition over the per-layer times; the boundary push carries the residual + AttnRes block state (1 + ceil(l/12) rows of 14,336 B per token). Fill/drain bubbles ignored (many chunks in flight).
AFD (D11): two microbatches ping-pong; per MoE layer max(A layer, F experts, A<->F transfer) per half batch; best of the A:F splits 56:16 / 48:24 / 40:32 per r.
open_questions: MoE activations for mxfp4_release prefill: MXFP8 (headline) or NVFP4 (the Rubin backend above 512 tokens/rank)?
Dispatch dedup with per-rank FP32 pre-combine (O2) changes the BF16 rounding order of the routed sum - acceptable as 'order may differ'?
KDA core precision: FlashKDA stages the FP32 state into BF16 MMAs in prefill; FP32/TF32 math would ~2x the prefill KDA core.
DcpExchange per-row bytes (X_topk) and the drafter forward row count per verify outcome are inferred, not read from kernels.
Rack-wide EP (D7/D8/P6) imbalance factor: SOL uses 1.0; which measured EPLB max/mean should the achievable column use?
KDA segment-scan context parallel for long prompts (P8) reorders the FP32 recurrence across ranks.
The FP32 SIMT rate and the MXFP4 GEMM rate are not measured on VR200; die-local 17.1 TB/s comes from a code docstring.
Spec values are NVIDIA's preliminary public figures and may change.
